name: Seasonal Picks
description: Picks movies from your watch history and the time of year.
overview: History- and calendar-aware movie picks as playlists (works on TV), a shared Suggested library, themed seasonal covers and a web Suggested screen.

versions.changelog: The home row starts on the first pick, and the ‹ › buttons move by whole cards, stopping at the same left margin as Jellyfin's other rows instead of running off the edge.

The home row has ‹ › buttons beside See all instead of a scrollbar (swipe still works on phones and tablets). A little more space between the home row title and its cards.

Each pick's reason is now a readable line under the title, instead of small text over the poster. The home row's cards are the same size as Jellyfin's other home rows. Choose where the home row goes: at the top, after any of the first six rows, or at the bottom. Choose portrait (poster) or thumb (landscape) cards for the home row. Now also runs on Jellyfin 10.11. Each release comes in two builds, one for 10.11 and one for 12, and Jellyfin installs the right one by itself.

Longer seasons now change their cover each week: Halloween (pumpkin patch, graveyard, haunted house, witch's cauldron), Christmas (tree, living room by the fire, Santa's sleigh, baubles and holly), winter (snowfall, snowy forest), Easter (bunny and eggs, basket of chicks), Valentine's (floating hearts, hearts and roses, heart balloons) and Chinese New Year (red lanterns, lantern festival). New Scene option in the cover designer: change each week, or always use one scene. It also lets you preview every scene. New days: Pancake Day (Shrove Tuesday, follows Easter) and Chinese New Year (New Year's Day to the Lantern Festival, follows the lunar calendar). Dates relative to Chinese New Year are written lunar+0, lunar+14 and so on. Remastered covers for New Year, Star Wars Day, Ghostbusters Day, Back to Hogwarts, St Patrick's Day, Bonfire Night and the out-of-season cover. Covers are more detailed, and decorations no longer cross the title or each other. The plugin now updates itself: new releases are installed by Jellyfin's Update Plugins task.
New logo, shown in the plugin catalog and on the plugin's page in the dashboard. Rewritten README with install steps, a getting started guide and answers to common questions.

Season rows on the settings page are no longer squashed: the name and dates show in full, and on phones the badges and the On box move to a second line. The settings page uses more of a wide screen, and the Picks settings sit in three tidy columns. Buttons such as Remove and Upload picture are readable again, and "Remove finished cover" only shows when there is an uploaded cover. What's new loads again on Jellyfin 12.1. On phones, the chosen tab scrolls into view. The Suggested screen fills the whole screen in older browsers.

Seasonal Picks now has its own entry in the dashboard side menu. New look for the settings page: tabs, a header showing what's on today and what's next, and seasons that fold up into a one-line summary with a cover thumbnail. The Save buttons stay at the bottom of the screen while you scroll. This changelog, under What's new.
